# Exhaustive UI Description

## 1) Sections Top to Bottom

### Status Bar (overlaid on map, white text/icons)
- Time: **3:48** (left)
- Small app icons: orange/white icon, **Z** (Zomato, red), blue icon, dark icon, and a **wrench** icon
- Center: circular **blue walking-person badge** (white pedestrian pictogram inside a blue circle with white ring, and a blue dot/tail pointing down — this is the user's location marker on the map)
- Right side: mute icon, **0.60 KB/s** with up/down arrows, **4G**, 📶 **Wi-Fi icon**, battery pill (~57%), **57%**
- Partially visible behind: another map marker showing "Of... stel" text and Tamil text (₹ maps label)

### Map Section (top ~215px)
- **Google Maps** light-style render: pale blue water tint (#BFE8F5-ish), light gray/white streets, green park patches
- Visible labels: **"SRM Easwari Engineering College"** (gray, centered ~x230), **"Thirumalai Street"** (rotated vertically, gray), **"Bharathi S..."** partially cut on right, **"Bharathi..."** faint
- **Google** logo watermark bottom-left, plus a small transit (bus/train) icon marker
- Rounded white "M" transit pin in center-right
- Bottom of map fades into a **cartoon illustration** of green trees/bushes, teal road, tiny buildings — a decorative skyline strip

### Headline Text (on map/illustration, dark navy #1A2B3C)
- Line 1: **"You are in ↗ Ramapuram."** — "You are in" regular, ↗ arrow icon, "Ramapuram" **bold underlined** (link style)
- Line 2: **"No buses available around you."**
- Font: ~24px semibold/bold, dark slate color

### Search Bar (floating over illustration edge)
- Full-width rounded pill (radius ~32px), **gradient: magenta/pink (#E91E8C) → red-orange (#FF3B1F)** left to right
- Text: **Search "Bus Stops"** — white, ~26px semibold, quotes included
- Right: **white magnifying glass icon**

### Transport Mode Selector (horizontal card row)
- White/light background (#F5F6FA page bg), horizontally scrollable row of white rounded cards (radius ~24px), each with 3D vehicle illustration on top and label below
- Cards left→right:
  1. **Bus** — white/silver 3D bus (partially cut off at left edge)
  2. **Metro** — white 3D metro train on rails
  3. **Train** — white/gray 3D train
  4. **Auto** — green/yellow auto-rickshaw
  5. Fifth card cut off at right edge (dark vehicle)
- Labels: dark gray, ~18px, centered under each image

### Promo Carousel Card
- Large rounded card (radius ~28px), **yellow (#FFD633)** background with white organic swoosh shapes
- Left content:
  - Giant **"₹1"** in dark navy, ~90px bold
  - **"₹1 Rupee Ticket"** (~26px bold, dark)
  - ⚡ **"1-Click Booking"** (with lightning emoji)
  - **"Powered by _CUMTA_"** (blue link text with underline)
- Right: **phone mockup** (dark rounded rectangle frame) containing:
  - 3D white bus image on **blue (#2E7CF6)** background
  - White ticket panel: red circular icon, **"CUMTA UPI"** bold, **"Powered by CUMTA"** small underlined, **"₹1"** right-aligned
  - **Blue "GET TICKET" button** (white text, pill radius)
- **Page dots** below card, centered: 4 dots — 2nd is dark/black (active), others gray

### Track Your Buses Section
- Heading: **"Track your buses"** — ~28px bold, near-black
- Sub-row: **"Nearby Stop:"** (~20px regular) left; right: **blue pill button "Show all ›"** (#1B7FE0, white text, radius pill)
- **"Ramapuram Srn University"** — dark, ~20px, **underlined link**
- Direction card below (white, radius ~20px, subtle shadow):
  - Header: **"Towards RAMAPURAM"** — gray ~20px, with light gray divider
  - Bus row: **"S26"** badge (yellow/amber #FFE08A rounded square, dark red-brown bold text), **"To Valasaravakkam"** (~24px bold dark), right: blue **broadcast/waves icon** + **"15 MIN"** in green monospace-style text on light pill
  - Partially visible second row: another **"S26"**-style badge cut off, **"EXP"** small gray label, **"SCHEDULED"** gray text, with a gray horizontal progress/loading bar below

### Bottom Navigation (floating white pill dock)
- White rounded pill, subtle shadow, floats over content
- 5 items:
  1. **Home** — red ticket-shaped icon (active, red #E53935), label dark bold
  2. **Tickets** — dark gray ticket/stub icon
  3. **BUS TICKET** — large **blue-purple gradient circle** (#5B6CF9→#4F46E5) elevated, white bus icon, tiny white label "BUS TICKET" below
  4. **Pass** — dark gray curved/pass icon
  5. **Account** — gray person icon

## 2) Layout Structure
- Single-column vertical scroll; map header full-bleed; horizontal scroll carousel for vehicle cards; promo card is a swipeable carousel (dots); bus-tracking card is a vertical list inside a card; bottom nav is a floating dock.

## 3) Color Palette
- Map water: #BFE9F5; streets: #FFFFFF/#E8EAED; greenery: #7BC67B / #34A853
- Headline text: #1A2B3C
- Search gradient: #E91E8C → #FF3B1F
- Page bg: #F5F6FA
- Promo yellow: #FFD633; link blue: #1A73E8; button blue: #1B7FE0 / #2E7CF6
- Badge yellow: #FFE08A; badge text: #7A3B10; green ETA: #1B8A3A
- Nav active red: #E53935; nav blue circle: #5B6CF9; grays: #5F6368, #9AA0A6

## 4) Icons
- Magnifier (white, search bar), walking-person blue badge, ↗ arrow, ⚡ emoji, red CUMTA circle logo, blue broadcast waves, red ticket (Home), gray tickets (Tickets), white bus in blue circle, gray pass icon, gray person icon

## 5) Typography
- Sans-serif (Roboto/Product Sans style). Headline ~24px bold; search ~26px semibold; card labels ~18px; "₹1" ~90px heavy; promo lines ~26px bold; section heading ~28px bold; bus row ~24px bold; "15 MIN"/"SCHEDULED" ~monospace-feel small caps; nav labels ~14px (bold for active).

## 6) Map / Interactive
- Live Google map with user-location walking marker, pan gestures, Google watermark; "Ramapuram" underlined location link; search input; scrollable vehicle cards; swipeable promo carousel with dots; "Show all" button; underlined nearby-stop link; live ETA row.

## 7) Bottom Navigation
- Present: 5-tab floating white pill — Home (active red), Tickets, elevated BUS TICKET gradient FAB, Pass, Account.
